entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that performs sidelink measurement object removal procedures as specified in TS 38.331.

entities.name: sl-MeasObjectToRemoveList
entities.description: List containing sl-MeasObjectId values to be removed from the UE's sidelink measurement configuration.

entities.name: sl-MeasObjectId
entities.description: Identifier for a sidelink measurement object in the UE configuration.

entities.name: VarMeasConfigSL
entities.description: UE variable storing the sidelink measurement configuration including sl-MeasObjectList and sl-MeasIdList.

entities.name: sl-MeasId
entities.description: Identifier for a sidelink measurement entry that links measurement objects to reporting configurations.

entities.name: periodical reporting timer
entities.description: Timer controlling periodic measurement reporting for a specific sl-MeasId.

entities.name: sl-TimeToTrigger
entities.description: Time-to-trigger parameter associated with sidelink measurement reporting.

entities.name: VarMeasReportListSL
entities.description: UE variable storing the list of active sidelink measurement reporting entries.

relations.description: sl-MeasObjectToRemoveList contains sl-MeasObjectId values to be removed.
UE removes the entry with matching sl-MeasObjectId from sl-MeasObjectList in VarMeasConfigSL.
UE removes all sl-MeasId associated with the removed sl-MeasObjectId from sl-MeasIdList.
sl-MeasId removal is triggered by the removal of its associated sl-MeasObjectId.
UE removes measurement reporting entry for removed sl-MeasId from VarMeasReportListSL.
UE stops the periodical reporting timer when sl-MeasId is removed.
UE resets associated information including sl-TimeToTrigger when sl-MeasId is removed.
